{{Quote|The Courts take even longer to decide things than the Senate.|[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The '''Supreme Court''' was the highest court of law in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and composed the judicial branch of the Republic. The Supreme Court was headquartered in the [[Galactic Courts of Justice/Legends|Galactic Courts of Justice Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. 

The Supreme Court survived into the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as the highest court until it was replaced by the [[Court of Justice]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] under the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

== Organization ==
The Supreme Court functioned as the Republic’s highest judicial authority and final appellate body, responsible for interpreting Republic law and the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|constitution]]. Its jurisdiction covered select constitutional and interstellar cases, including disputes involving member states, the Republic government, non-Republic litigants, and matters related to interstellar travel and commerce. The Court exercised discretionary review and accepted only a limited number of appeals, primarily those raising constitutional questions.<ref name=":0">[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide|''The Clone Wars Campaign Guide'']]</ref>

== Composition ==
The Court was composed of twelve justices, one of whom served as Chief Justice. The Chief Justice was nominated by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] and approved by the remaining justices, while associate justices were nominated by the Chancellor and confirmed by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. <ref name=":0" />

==History==
The Supreme Court made four trials relating to [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Governor of Naboo/Legends|Governor]] [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] was displeased by Gunray retaining his position as viceroy despite the trials.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> 

During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Supreme Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ultimately replaced all but five of the justices, including the Chief Justice.<ref name=":0" />
